samuel1.23.p1.b1.text: Look, the Philistines are fighting against Keilah and looting the threshing floors.

samuel1.23.p1.b2.text: Should I go and attack these Philistines?

samuel1.23.p1.b3.text: Go and attack the Philistines and save Keilah.

samuel1.23.p2.b1.text: Look, we are afraid here in Judah; how much more if we go to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?

samuel1.23.p2.b2.text: Go at once to Keilah, for I will deliver the Philistines into your hand.

samuel1.23.p2.b3.text: … So David saved the people of Keilah.

samuel1.23.p3.b1.text: Now Abiathar son of Ahimelech had brought the ephod with him when he fled to David at Keilah.

samuel1.23.p3.b2.text: When Saul was told that David had gone to Keilah, …

samuel1.23.p3.b3.text: God has delivered him into my hand, for he has trapped himself by entering a town with gates and bars.

samuel1.23.p4.b2.text: Will the citizens of Keilah surrender me into his hand? Will Saul come down, as Your servant has heard?

samuel1.23.p4.b4.text: Then David and his men, about six hundred strong, set out and departed from Keilah, moving from place to place.

samuel1.23.p5.b1.text: And David stayed in the wilderness strongholds and in the hill country of the Wilderness of Ziph.

samuel1.23.p5.b2.text: Day after day Saul searched for him,

samuel1.23.p5.b3.text: While David was in Horesh in the Wilderness of Ziph, he saw that Saul had come out to take his life.

samuel1.23.p5.b4.text: but God would not deliver David into his hand.

samuel1.23.p6.b1.text: And Saul’s son Jonathan came to David in Horesh and strengthened his hand in God,

samuel1.23.p6.b2.text: Do not be afraid, for my father Saul will never lay a hand on you. And you will be king over Israel, and I will be your second-in-command.

samuel1.23.p6.b3.text: Even my father Saul knows this is true.

samuel1.23.p6.b4.text: So the two of them made a covenant before the LORD. And David remained in Horesh, while Jonathan went home.

samuel1.23.p7.b1.text: Is not David hiding among us in the strongholds at Horesh, on the hill of Hachilah south of Jeshimon? … Now, O king, come down whenever your soul desires, and we will be responsible for delivering him into your hand.

samuel1.23.p7.b2.text: May you be blessed by the LORD, … for you have had compassion on me.

samuel1.23.p7.b3.text: If he is in the land, I will search him out among all the clans of Judah.

samuel1.23.p7.b4.text: Now David and his men were in the Wilderness of Maon in the Arabah south of Jeshimon, …

samuel1.23.p8.b1.text: When David was told about it, he went down to the rock and stayed in the Wilderness of Maon.

samuel1.23.p8.b2.text: Saul was proceeding along one side of the mountain, and David and his men along the other side.

samuel1.23.p8.b3.text: Come quickly, for the Philistines have raided the land!

samuel1.23.p8.b4.text: So Saul broke off his pursuit of David … That is why that place is called Sela-hammahlekoth.
